title: Oven-Baked Oozy Slovakian Mozzarella Balls Bake
description: Rich and juicy Slovakian-inspired dish featuring mozzarella balls baked to perfection. Perfect for a crowd-pleasing vegetarian dinner.

ingredients.name: Mozzarella Balls
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, store-bought or homemade

ingredients.name: Granulated Sugar
ingredients.notes: Optional, for a hint of sweetness

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together flour, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Dust the baking dish with the flour mixture, tapping out any excess.
Place the mozzarella balls in a single layer on the prepared baking dish.
Brush the tops of the mozzarella balls with butter and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Drizzle the olive oil over the breaded mozzarella balls.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the mozzarella balls are baking, beat the egg in a small bowl.
Remove the baking dish from the oven and brush the egg wash over the mozzarella balls.
Return the baking dish to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the egg is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.
